The '''Esyram system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="XWvTF" /> located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Battle of Esyram|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near [[Esyram]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
